summary: The PR addresses the issue by sorting the centers before calculating bin edges, ensuring np.digitize works correctly. The added scripts are for demonstration and testing purposes.

issues.description: The addition of new scripts (edge_cases.py and reproduce.py) is not directly related to fixing the bug and could be considered scope creep. These should ideally be part of the test suite or documentation.

The new scripts do not follow the typical structure of test files in scikit-learn and could benefit from following project conventions, such as using pytest and being located in the appropriate test directory.
